newsitem.title: USA: DLB Oil gets 92 pct of Bonray in bid.
newsitem.headline: DLB Oil gets 92 pct of Bonray in bid.

text.p: DLB Oil & Gas Inc said Monday its tender offer to buy Bonray Drilling Corp for $30 per share was accepted by 92 percent of Bonray shareholders.
Under terms of the offer, DLB will acquire Bonray's 423,540 shares outstanding. Bonray will then become a unit of DLB, DLB said.
DLB added that after the acquisition, the DLB/Donray fleet will have 15 rigs, including six capabale of drilling wells over 20,000 feet and nine from 7,500 feet to 15,000 feet.
DLB officials were not immediateoly available to comment.
